login.title: egzamin-b1.pl
login.eyebrow: Polish state exam · B1 and other levels
login.headline: Prepare for the Polish exam with an AI assistant
login.lead: Mock sets in the format of the state exam. The AI assistant analyses your grammar mistakes, checks writing and speaking and highlights your weak spots.
login.f1Text: All 5 parts — Słuchanie, Czytanie, Gramatyka, Pisanie, Mówienie — timed like the real exam.
login.f2Text: Checks Pisanie and Mówienie against the Commission criteria and explains mistakes in your language.
login.f3Text: Mistakes are collected in “My top mistakes” by topic, and AI adds a short rule to each one.
login.f4Text: Exam structure, scoring criteria, Polish handwriting.
footer.disclaimer: An independent project, not affiliated with the State Commission for the Certification of Proficiency in Polish as a Foreign Language or with NAWA. Official exam papers are © the Commission and are used here for educational purposes only; originals: {site}.

account.warning: The account {email} will be deleted together with all its data: exam results, answers, the mistakes register and group memberships. A teacher also loses their groups. This cannot be undone.
